name: BEND WINSUPPLY CO
address: 1320 SE ARMOUR ROAD BLD D, BEND, OR 97702

fr.recommendations:
• Mark each building with a clearly visible address or unit identifier on all sides facing access roads and drive aisles.

• Mark the access road entry point with the property address using reflective signage visible from both directions of approach.

• Post a site map at the primary access road entry showing the location of all buildings, the drive aisle layout, and the outdoor storage area.

• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles and stored materials to allow emergency vehicles to move between buildings.

• Mark the outdoor storage area boundaries so responders can quickly identify its extent and avoid staging emergency vehicles adjacent to it.

• Identify and mark any dead-end drive aisle segments so responding crews know in advance where turnaround space is limited.

• Where rear access to buildings is restricted, mark the nearest accessible approach point so responders do not lose time searching for a workable position.

• Keep a minimum clear width maintained through the drive aisle at all times, particularly near the outdoor storage area where encroachment is most likely.

• Assign a distinct identifier to each detached building and include those identifiers on the site map so responders can distinguish between structures during an incident.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim any tree branches that hang over or touch the building cluster to reduce direct pathways from tree canopy to rooftops.
• Remove dead or dry grass accumulated against the base of buildings within the cluster.
• Thin shrubs that have grown close to building walls or entrances within the cluster.
• Keep the large paved area clear of dead grass, leaf litter, and any debris that could carry fire toward the buildings.
• Clear vegetation from the rear of the buildings to improve movement and access for firefighters working in that area.
• Keep rear access routes passable by removing any vegetation, debris, or obstructions that reduce clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Maintain existing separation between scattered trees and shrubs and the building cluster by preventing new vegetation growth from bridging that open space.
